'''Qlik''' ({{IPAc-en|k|l|ɪ|k}}; formerly known as '''Qliktech''') provides a [[data integration]], analytics, and [[artificial intelligence]] platform.<ref>{{cite web |title=CRN honors Qlik with a Spot on Its 2024 Big Data 100 List |url=https://www.martechcube.com/crn-honors-qlik-with-a-spot-on-its-2024-big-data-100-list/ |website=MarTech Cube |date=April 23, 2024}}</ref> The [[software]] company was founded in 1993 in [[Lund, Sweden]] and is now based in [[King of Prussia, Pennsylvania]], United States. Thoma Bravo made the company private in 2016.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Tharakan |first1=Anya George |title=Thoma Bravo to buy analytics firm Qlik in $3 billion deal |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSKCN0YO2AV/ |website=Reuters |date=June 2, 2016}}</ref>

Qlik Data Integration (QDI) includes tools such as ''Qlik Replicate'' for data replication, ''Qlik Catalog'' for data organization, ''Qlik Compose'' for automation of data lakes and data warehouses, and ''Qlik Talend Cloud'' for maintenance of data integrity.<ref name="Angle"/><ref>{{cite web |last1=King |first1=Tim |title=The 18 Best Data Replication Software and Tools for 2024 |url=https://solutionsreview.com/data-integration/the-best-data-replication-software/ |website=Solutions Review |date=October 13, 2023}}</ref> Qlik's AI program enables AI-powered analytics, natural language capabilities, and visualizations.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Abdullahi |first1=Aminu |title=9 Top AI Governance Tools 2024 |url=https://www.eweek.com/artificial-intelligence/ai-governance-tools/ |website=eWEEK |date=February 28, 2024}}</ref> ''Qlik Answers'' generates answers to questions from [[unstructured data]] sources.<ref name="Silicon"/> It also includes AutoML for no-code development of predictive models and tools for low-latency data processing.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Avidon |first1=Eric |title=Staige: A new Qlik portfolio for traditional AI, genAI and ML|url=https://www.techtarget.com/searchbusinessanalytics/news/366551876/Staige-a-new-Qlik-portfolio-for-traditional-AI-genAI-and-ML |website=TechTarget |date=September 12, 2023}}</ref>

== History ==

| align =
| direction = vertical
| width =
| image1 = Qlik-Logo RGB.jpg

| caption2 =
| footer = Historic logos of Qlik}}
The company was founded in Lund, Sweden in 1993, by Björn Berg and Staffan Gestrelius. Its Swedish headquarters are still in Lund.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-1000606175|title=JVP makes 4,000% return on QlikTech|website=Globes|date=December 6, 2010 |language=he|access-date=2019-05-31}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nlsinsight.com/post/meet-our-mentors-staffan-gestrelius-co-founder-of-qliktech|title=Meet our Mentors – Staffan Gestrelius, co-founder of Qliktech - Ideon Science Park {{!}} Nordic Life Science Insight|website=www.nlsinsight.com|access-date=2019-05-31}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://oresundstartups.com/success-stories-might-missed-qlik/|title=The Success Stories You Probably Haven't Heard Of: Qlik|date=2014-04-27|website=Øresund Startups|language=en-US|access-date=2019-05-31}}</ref>  The company's first product, QuikView (now called QlikView), was built to enable users to retrieve detailed data analysis from various systems.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=https://industrifonden.com/success-stories/qlik/|title=Success Stories|website=Industrifonden|language=en-US|access-date=2019-05-31}}</ref> Måns Hultman became CEO in 2000, and Lars Björk became CFO.<ref name=":2" />

The first version of the product came out in 1994, and a patent application was made in 1995.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://translate.google.com/translate?hl=en&sl=sv&u=https://www.millnetbi.se/nyheter/kunskap/qlikview-och-dess-historia.html&prev=search|title=Google Translate|website=translate.google.com|access-date=2019-06-04}}</ref> ''QUIK'', in the original name of the product, stood for Quality, Understanding, Interaction, and Knowledge.<ref name=":2" />

QlikView 2 came out in 1996, QlikView 3 in 1997,<ref name=":0" />  and QlikView 4 in 1999. In 1998, the company received funding from Swedish investors [[Handelsbanken]] and Industrifonden<ref name=":2" />

The company focused on the area of business intelligence, growing from 35 employees in 1999 to 70 in 2003.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://artificialintelligence-news.com/2019/09/16/elif-tutuk-qlik-on-securing-data-literacy-and-the-evolution-of-ai-with-bi/|title=Elif Tutuk, Qlik: On securing data literacy and the evolution of AI with BI|last=Bourne|first=James|date=2019-09-16|website=AI News|language=en-GB|access-date=2019-09-19}}</ref> In 2004, the firm decided to expand internationally and moved the company headquarters to the U.S., while development stayed in Lund.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://industrifonden.com/success-stories/qlik/|title=Qlik|website=Industrifonden|language=en-US|access-date=2019-08-23}}</ref> That year, it secured $12.5 million in venture capital funding from equity firms [[Accel Partners]] and [[Jerusalem Venture Partners]].<ref name=":2" />

QlikView 7 was released in 2005, and the single-user desktop tool was replaced with a server-based web tool.<ref>[http://www.globes.co.il/en/article-1000606175 JVP makes 4,000% return on QlikTech] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131203060453/http://www.globes.co.il/serveen/globes/docview.asp?did=1000606175&fid=1725|date=December 3, 2013}}</ref> In 2006, the company had $44 million in revenue.<ref name=":3" />

In 2007, Lars Björk became CEO.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://swedishstartupspace.com/2016/04/29/lars-bjork-big-winner-qlik-takeover/|title=Lars Björk Is The Big Winner of the Qlik Takeover - Swedish Startup Space|access-date=2018-08-07|language=sv-SE|archive-date=August 7, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180807155453/http://swedishstartupspace.com/2016/04/29/lars-bjork-big-winner-qlik-takeover/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20171011005699/en/Qlik-Announces-CEO-Transition|title=Qlik Announces CEO Transition|access-date=2018-08-07|language=en}}</ref>

As of April 2011, the company had a [[market capitalization]] over $2 billion.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jvpvc.com/funds-about|title=JVP Venture Capital|date=2011-02-05|work=About}}</ref> In 2012, [[Forbes]] listed it as one of America's top three fastest-growing tech companies.<ref name=":2" />

In 2012, Qlik acquired Expressor Software for metadata management.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2012-06-12|title=QlikTech Acquires Expressor Software to Deliver the Data Users Need with the Governance IT Requires|url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20120612005570/en/QlikTech-Acquires-Expressor-Software-to-Deliver-the-Data-Users-Need-with-the-Governance-IT-Requires|access-date=2021-07-13|website=www.businesswire.com|language=en}}</ref>

In 2013, the company opened an office in [[Perth|Perth, Australia]], due to its large consumer base in that country.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.itwire.com/it-people-news/people/59649-qliktech-new-appointment-new-wa-office|title=QlikTech new appointment, new WA office|last=Dinham|first=Peter|website=ITWire}}</ref><ref>[http://www.itwire.com/it-people-news/people/59649-qliktech-new-appointment-new-wa-office QlikTech new appointment, new WA office]</ref> In August 2015, the company expanded its research and development operations by opening an office in [[Ottawa|Ottawa, Ontario]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://krpproperties.com/qlik-opens-first-canadian-rd-office-in-kanata/|title=Qlik opens first Canadian R&D office in Kanata|last=DZG|date=2015-08-24|website=KRP Properties|language=en-US|access-date=2019-07-05}}</ref>

In 2015 Qlik acquired Vizubi and its NPrinting product.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.element61.be/en/resource/nprinting-functionalities-benefits-qlik-nprinting-17|title=NPrinting – What it is and why you will like it - Functionalities and Benefits of Qlik NPrinting 17|date=2016-04-29|website=element61|language=en|access-date=2019-11-01}}</ref>

In 2016, private equity firms [[Bain Capital]], [[Permira]], and [[Thoma Bravo]] submitted offers to buy Qlik.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://swedishstartupspace.com/2016/04/29/lars-bjork-big-winner-qlik-takeover/|title=Lars Björk Is The Big Winner of the Qlik Takeover - Swedish Startup Space|website=swedishstartupspace.com|language=sv-SE|access-date=2019-07-05|archive-date=August 7, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180807155453/http://swedishstartupspace.com/2016/04/29/lars-bjork-big-winner-qlik-takeover/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2016-04-28/qlik-tech-said-to-draw-bids-from-thoma-bravo-bain-permira|title=Qlik Tech Said to Draw Bids From Thoma Bravo, Bain, Permira|date=2019-07-04|access-date=2019-07-05|language=en}}</ref> In June, the firm announced that it agreed to sell itself to Thoma Bravo for about $3 billion.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-qlik-m-a-thoma-bravo-idUSKCN0YO1JD|title=Thoma Bravo to buy analytics firm Qlik in $3 billion deal|date=2016-06-02|work=Reuters|access-date=2019-07-05|language=en}}</ref> In 2017, CEO Lars Bjork transitioned his responsibilities to David Murphy as interim CEO; Mike Capone was named CEO in January 2018.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20171011005699/en/Qlik-Announces-CEO-Transition|title=Qlik Announces CEO Transition|date=2017-10-11|website=www.businesswire.com|language=en|access-date=2019-07-05}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.computerworlduk.com/data/qlik-launches-industrys-only-end-end-data-platform-3696832/|title=Qlik touts industry's only end-to-end data platform after Attunity buy|last=Macaulay|first=Tom|website=ComputerworldUK|access-date=2019-07-05}}</ref>

In 2017, Qlik started working with Philadelphia, Pennsylvania-based [[Thomas Jefferson University]] and [[Jefferson Health]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://medcitynews.com/2017/06/jefferson-health-qlik/|title=Jefferson Health utilizes Qlik for analytics support|last=Dietsche|first=Erin|date=2017-06-15|website=MedCity News|language=en-US|access-date=2019-11-05}}</ref> The two worked together to use data to identify situations where healthcare officials could prescribe fewer opioids, helping to combat the opioid epidemic in Philadelphia.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.phillymag.com/healthcare-news/2019/07/17/data-analytics-opioid-epidemic-philadelphia/|title=How Data Analytics Has Curbed the Prescription of Opioids in Philly|date=2019-07-17|website=Philadelphia Magazine|language=en-US|access-date=2019-11-05}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cio.com/article/3366238/culture-key-to-data-driven-transformation-at-jefferson-health.html|title=Culture key to data-driven transformation at Jefferson Health|last=Olavsrud|first=Thor|date=2019-03-19|website=CIO|language=en|access-date=2019-11-05|archive-date=August 21, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190821000050/https://www.cio.com/article/3366238/culture-key-to-data-driven-transformation-at-jefferson-health.html|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://healthtechmagazine.net/article/2019/05/how-predictive-analytics-healthcare-changing-hospitals-perfcon|author=Jen Miller|title=How Predictive Analytics in Healthcare Is Changing Hospitals}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.zdnet.com/article/sydney-healthcare-clinicians-turn-to-data-analytics-to-improve-back-pain-treatments/|title=Sydney healthcare clinicians turn to data analytics to improve back pain treatments|last=Chanthadavong|first=Aimee|website=ZDNet|language=en|access-date=2019-11-05}}</ref>

In 2017 Idevio (Geo Analytics) was acquired by Qlik,<ref>{{Cite web|date=2017-01-26|title=Qlik Takes to the Cloud, Buys GeoAnalytics Firm|url=https://www.datanami.com/2017/01/25/qlik-takes-cloud-buys-geoanalytics-firm/|access-date=2020-07-07|website=Datanami}}</ref> and data catalog company Podium Data<ref>{{Cite web|last=Brust|first=Andrew|title=Podium Data becomes Qlik Data Catalyst|url=https://www.zdnet.com/article/podium-data-becomes-qlik-data-catalyst/|access-date=2021-07-05|website=ZDNet|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Qlik analytics platform keeps focus on active intelligence|url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/news/252497092/Qlik-analytics-platform-keeps-focus-on-active-intelligence|access-date=2021-07-05|website=SearchBusinessAnalytics|language=en}}</ref> in 2018.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.zdnet.com/article/qlik-to-acquire-attunity-for-560m/|title=Qlik to Acquire Attunity for $560M|last=Brust|first=Andrew|website=ZDNet|language=en|access-date=2019-10-23}}</ref> In 2019, the company acquired an AI, natural language bot company, Crunch Data, who it had partnered with for 4 years prior to the acquisition.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/news/252456486/Qliks-CrunchBot-acquisition-adds-AI-chatbot-to-analytics|title=Qlik's CrunchBot acquisition adds AI chatbot to analytics|website=SearchBusinessAnalytics|language=en|access-date=2019-11-01}}</ref> Crunch Data was integrated into its Insight Advisor product.<ref>{{Cite web|title=New NLP capabilities highlight Qlik Sense update|url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/news/252488933/New-NLP-capabilities-highlight-Qlik-Sense-update|access-date=2021-07-05|website=SearchBusinessAnalytics|language=en}}</ref>

In 2019, the company acquired data integration company Attunity<ref>{{Cite news|date=2019-02-24|title=Attunity CEO: We can help Qlik grow in big data|language=en|work=Globes|url=https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-qlik-acquires-attunity-for-560m-1001275401|access-date=2021-07-07}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Active intelligence continues to guide Qlik roadmap|url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/news/252500542/Active-intelligence-continues-to-guide-Qlik-roadmap|access-date=2021-07-07|website=SearchBusinessAnalytics|language=en|archive-date=July 9, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210709183142/https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/news/252500542/Active-intelligence-continues-to-guide-Qlik-roadmap|url-status=dead}}</ref> for $560M which expanded its footprint in the Boston area.

In 2020, the company acquired Knarr Analytic for its real-time collaboration and insight capture capabilities.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bizjournals.com/philadelphia/news/2020/08/25/qlik-acquires-atlanta-based-firm-knarr-analytics.html|title=Qlik's growth strategy continues with acquisition of Atlanta firm's IP and assets|last=Caffrey|first=Michelle|date=2020-08-25|website=Philadelphia Business Journal|access-date=2020-10-16}}</ref> The same year, the company acquired RoxAI for its Ping Alerting and intelligent automation software,<ref>{{cite news |last1=SCHLABACH |first1=ALIZA |title=Why KOP-based Qlik is acquiring London startup RoxAI |url=https://www.bizjournals.com/philadelphia/news/2020/01/22/why-kp-based-qlik-is-acquiring-london-startup.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Avidon |first1=Eric |title=Active intelligence continues to guide Qlik roadmap |url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/news/252500542/Active-intelligence-continues-to-guide-Qlik-roadmap |website=Search Business Analytics |access-date=July 2, 2021 |archive-date=July 9, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210709183142/https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/news/252500542/Active-intelligence-continues-to-guide-Qlik-roadmap |url-status=dead }}</ref> and Blendr.io for its data integration platform-as-a-service (iPaaS) to allow for data integration and automation to hundreds of SaaS-based business applications.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Leopold |first1=George |title=Qlik Continues Buying Spree with Blendr.io Deal |url=https://www.datanami.com/2020/10/22/qlik-continues-buying-spree-with-blendr-io-deal/ |date=October 22, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Avidon |first1=Eric |title=AI capabilities a target for merger and acquisition activity |url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/feature/AI-capabilities-a-target-for-merger-and-acquisition-activity |date=June 3, 2021}}</ref>
Qlik was used by the [[Wrightington, Wigan and Leigh NHS Foundation Trust]] NHS patient data during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=NHS trust expedites data management with Qlik in pandemic|url=https://www.computerweekly.com/news/252496084/NHS-trust-expedites-data-management-with-Qlik-in-pandemic|access-date=2021-03-10|website=ComputerWeekly.com|language=en}}</ref>

In 2021, the company introduced Qlik Application Automation, which automates tasks and data workflows between Qlik Cloud and SaaS applications.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Qlik bursts out of data vis, makes play for automation|url=https://www.theregister.com/2021/10/01/qlik_automation/|access-date=2021-10-26|website=www.theregister.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=King|first=Timothy|date=2021-09-28|title=Qlik Follows Up Blendr.io Acquisition with New Application Automation Tool|url=https://solutionsreview.com/data-integration/qlik-follows-up-blendr-io-acquisition-with-new-application-automation-tool/|access-date=2021-10-26|website=Best Data Integration Vendors, News & Reviews for Big Data, Applications, ETL and Hadoop|language=en-US}}</ref> The same year, the company acquired Salt Lake City-based Big Squid, a leading provider of no-code automated machine learning.<ref>{{Cite web|last=TechBuzz|title=Qlik Acquires Big Squid|url=https://www.techbuzz.news/qlik-acquires-big-squid/|access-date=2021-12-10|website=www.techbuzz.news|date=October 27, 2021 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Whiting|first=Rick|date=2021-09-30|title=Qlik Expands Into Machine Learning Realm With Big Squid Acquisition|url=https://www.crn.com/news/applications-os/qlik-expands-into-machine-learning-realm-with-big-squid-acquisition|access-date=2021-12-10|website=CRN}}</ref> The company also went on to acquire NodeGraph, a customizable metadata management solution, to help expand its analytics data pipeline capabilities.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Livemint|date=2021-08-13|title=Qlik acquires NodeGraph to enhance analytics capabilities|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/qlik-acquires-nodegraph-to-enhance-analytics-capabilities-11628847720424.html|access-date=2021-12-10|website=mint|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Qlik named as Challenger in Gartner MQ for Data Integration Tools for 6th consecutive year|url=https://channellife.com.au/story/qlik-named-as-challenger-in-gartner-mq-for-data-integration-tools-for-6th-consecutive-year|access-date=2021-12-10|website=channellife.com.au|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Cameron (CMO)|first=Nadia|title=CMO's top 8 martech stories for the week - 19 August 21|url=https://www.cmo.com.au/article/690642/cmo-top-8-martech-stories-week-19-august-21/|access-date=2021-12-10|website=www.cmo.com.au|language=en-au}}</ref>

In 2022, Qlik confidentially filed papers for [[Initial public offering|IPO]] with the [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] to go public.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Qlik Announces Confidential Submission of Draft Registration Statement Related to Proposed Public Offering|url=https://www.qlik.com/us/company/press-room/press-releases/qlik-announces-confidential-submission-of-draft-registration-proposed-public-offering|access-date=2022-01-10|website=Qlik|language=en}}</ref>

In 2023, Qlik acquired Talend combining its data integration solutions with Talend’s data transformation, quality, and governance Capabilities.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Qlik Acquires Talend|url=https://www.qlik.com/us/company/press-room/press-releases/qlik-acquires-talend|access-date=2024-01-03|website=Qlik|language=en}}</ref>{{primary source inline|date=May 2024}}

In December 2023, Qlik acquired Mozaic Data, which introduced a Data Product Catalog to streamline data management.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Azhar |first1=Ali |title=Qlik Acquires Mozaic Data to Help Simplify Data Management for Enterprises |url=https://www.datanami.com/2023/12/22/qlik-acquires-mosaic-data-to-help-simplify-data-management-for-enterprises/ |website=Datanami |date=December 22, 2023}}</ref>

In January 2024, Qlik acquired Kyndi, which focused on natural language processing and generative AI to ameliorate the processing of unstructured data.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Whiting |first1=Rick |title=Qlik Expands Unstructured Data Analysis Capabilities With Acquisition |url=https://www.crn.com/news/software/2024/qlik-acquisition-expands-unstructured-data-analysis-capabilities |website=CRN |date=January 19, 2024}}</ref>

==Products==
Qlik's Associative Engine lets users do [[big data]] analytics, combining a number of data sources so that associations and connections can be formed across the data.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/feature/Qlik-Research-head-talks-Associative-Engine-NLP-and-Data-Swarm|title=Qlik Research head talks Associative Engine, NLP and Data Swarm|website=SearchBusinessAnalytics|language=en|access-date=2019-08-15}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://dzone.com/articles/associative-data-modeling-demystified|title=Associative Data Modeling Demystified: Part V - DZone Big Data|website=dzone.com|language=en|access-date=2019-08-15|archive-date=August 15, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190815145533/https://dzone.com/articles/associative-data-modeling-demystified|url-status=dead}}</ref> The two main data analytics products,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Qlik Sense vs. QlikView: How the two Qlik tools compare|url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/feature/Qlik-Sense-vs-QlikView-How-the-two-Qlik-tools-compare|access-date=2021-07-09|website=SearchBusinessAnalytics|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=Tableau or Qlik: What separates the data visualization tools?|language=en-US|work=SearchBusinessAnalytics|url=https://searchbusinessanalytics.techtarget.com/feature/Tableau-or-Qlik-What-separates-the-data-visualization-tools|access-date=2021-07-09}}</ref> Qlik Sense (current cloud-based software) and QlikView (legacy on-premise product), serve different purposes running on the same engine. QlikView for analyzing static data, while Qlik Sense allows [[concatenation]] of different data sources, allowing drill-down on an individual data record.<ref>{{cite web |title=Blog - QlikView vs. Qlik Sense |url=https://primaconsulting.co.uk/news/2018/3/26/qlikview-vs-qliksense |website=Prima Consulting UK|date=May 2, 2018 }}</ref>

The Qlik Data Analytics Platform (QDA) offers direct access to Qlik's Associative data engine through open and standard APIs.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.analytics8.com/insights/qlik-sense-server-vs-qlik-analytics-platform/|title=Qlik Sense Server vs. Qlik Analytics Platform|date=2016-06-03|website=Analytics8|language=en-US|access-date=2019-09-06}}</ref> Qlik Data Catalyst is an enterprise data catalog<ref>{{Cite web|last=King|first=Timothy|date=2021-02-23|title=The 20 Best Data Catalog Tools and Software for 2021|url=https://solutionsreview.com/data-management/the-best-data-catalog-tools-and-software/|access-date=2021-07-09|website=Best Data Management Software, Vendors and Data Science Platforms|language=en-US}}</ref> management product,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.informatec.com/en/qlik-data-catalyst|title=Qlik Data Catalyst™ - Analytical data pre-processing "on-demand" for QlikView & Qlik Sense|website=www.informatec.com|access-date=2019-09-06|archive-date=September 15, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190915135813/https://www.informatec.com/en/qlik-data-catalyst|url-status=dead}}</ref> and Qlik Core is an analytics development platform built around Qlik's Associative engine and company-authored open source libraries.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.axisgroup.com/data-industry-insights-blog/qlik-core-jump-start|title=Qlik Core Jump Start|last=Kokenes|first=Speros|website=www.axisgroup.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-09|archive-date=October 9, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191009160337/https://www.axisgroup.com/data-industry-insights-blog/qlik-core-jump-start|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.zdnet.com/article/qlik-hits-reset-button-rolls-out-new-cloud-ai-developer-capabilities/|title=Qlik hits reset button, rolls out new cloud, AI, and developer capabilities|last=Henschen|first=Doug|website=ZDNet|language=en|access-date=2019-10-09}}</ref>

The Qlik Branch platform and open APIs allow third-party developers to create add-ons that extend Qlik Sense's [[Data visualization|visualization]] capabilities. Some of the Qlik Sense extension producers include ancoreSoft, [[AnyChart]], Applybi, ExtendBI, Inphinity, TrueChart, and Vizlib.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.computerweekly.com/news/252476152/Inside-Qliks-data-management-playbook|title=Inside Qlik's data management playbook|date=2020-01-02|website=[[Computer Weekly]]|access-date=2023-04-08}}</ref>

As in-house add-on products, Qlik GeoAnalytics provides mapping capabilities and built-in support for geoanalytic use cases,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.informatec.com/en/technologies/qlik/qlik-geoanalytics|title=Qlik GeoAnalytics {{!}} Informatec|website=www.informatec.com|access-date=2019-11-26}}</ref> Qlik DataMarket provides access to a cloud-based service with a variety of external data content that can be used to cross-reference and augment users’ data,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ometis.co.uk/qlik-software/qlik-datamarket/|title=Qlik DataMarket|website=Ometis|language=en-GB|access-date=2019-11-26}}</ref><ref name="bi-survey.com">{{Cite web|url=https://bi-survey.com/product/qlik-qlik-sense|title=Qlik Sense|website=BI Survey|language=en-US|access-date=2019-11-26}}</ref> and Qlik Connectors  are tools that allow QlikView and Qlik Sense to interact with external data sources not accessible through normal [[Open Database Connectivity|ODBC]] or [[OLE-DB]] data connections<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.aculytics.net/products/qlik-connectors/|title=Overview {{!}} Qlik connectors|website=Aculytics}}</ref>

The Qlik Data Integration platform, (QDI) includes Qlik Replicate for data replication and real-time data ingestion,<ref>{{cite news |last1=King |first1=Timothy |title=DBTA 100 2021: 20 Data Integration Vendors Our Editors Are Tracking |url=https://solutionsreview.com/data-integration/dbta-100-2021-data-integration-vendors-our-editors-are-tracking/ |date=June 11, 2021}}</ref> Qlik Catalog for organizing data,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Carew |first1=Joseph M. |title=Data catalog comparison to help you choose your best fit |url=https://searchdatamanagement.techtarget.com/feature/Data-catalog-comparison-to-help-you-choose-your-best-fit |date=February 4, 2021}}</ref> and Qlik Compose for data lakes and data warehouse automation.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Brust |first1=Andrew |title=Azure Synapse Analytics: A progress report |url=https://www.zdnet.com/article/azure-synapse-analytics-a-progress-report/ |date=July 24, 2020}}</ref> Qlik Talend Cloud introduces AI augmented data integration and quality capabilities.<ref name="Angle">{{cite web |last1=Wheatley |first1=Mike |title=Qlik debuts new data integration and curation tools for generative AI systems |url=https://siliconangle.com/2024/06/06/qlik-debuts-new-data-integration-curation-tools-generative-ai-systems/ |website=SiliconANGLE |date=June 6, 2024}}</ref>

Qlik Answers generates answers to questions from unstructured data sources.<ref name="Silicon">{{cite web |last1=Stevens |first1=Ryan |title=Qlik Answers aims to enable data-first AI adoption model |url=https://siliconangle.com/2024/06/06/qlik-answers-data-centric-strategy-streamline-generative-ai-adoption-qlikconnect/ |website=SiliconANGLE |date=June 6, 2024}}</ref>

== Finances ==
On June 2, 2016, private equity firm Thoma Bravo announced that it would acquire Qlik in an all-cash deal valued at approximately $3 billion.<ref name="Tharakan">{{cite web |last1=Tharakan |first1=Anya George |title=Thoma Bravo to buy analytics firm Qlik in $3 billion deal |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-qlik-m-a-thoma-bravo-idUSKCN0YO1JD/ |website=Reuters |date=June 2, 2016}}</ref> The acquisition was completed in August 2016.<ref>{{cite web |title=Thoma Bravo completes acquisition of Qlik |website=[[Reuters]] |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/idUKFWN1B307I/ |date=August 22, 2016}}</ref> Thoma Bravo paid $30.50 per share for Qlik, representing a 40% percent premium to the Company's unaffected 10 day average stock price prior to March 3, 2016 of $21.83.<ref name="Tharakan"/>

In January 2022, ''[[ZDNET]]'' reported that Qlik had confidentially filed papers with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to go public again.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Brust |first1=Andrew |title=Qlik confidentially registers for IPO |url=https://www.zdnet.com/article/qlik-registers-for-ipo/ |website=ZDNET |language=en |date=January 6, 2022}}</ref>
